summary: Compute the net change of a variable between two periods and publish it as a new GeoZarr dataset

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to load (as listed under /datasets).

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the change dataset to publish. If no static dataset template exists yet, OCS auto-registers one on publish.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable/band name carried through to the published change dataset.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings. The change is computed between the earliest and latest time step within this range (last − first).
